headline: First new booking in eight days, Richie, and it has no call time on it. Six replies from the last four days are still untagged.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Pin Richie's call time before anything else. Doctrine is explicit that a booking with no set time slips, and his row carries a Booked tick with no date booked, no call date and no status. Then work the six untagged replies: Alexander Cano, Jack trades, Leppan, Alexandra flame, Nick sanders and Matthew Chamberlin. Four call outcomes are still blank as well, Robert, luca, Evan and Joshua Haber, and with five working days left those four are the whole of August's cash.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Six unworked replies. Supply has restarted, seven replies in five days after four days of nothing, so the question is no longer whether leads arrive. It is whether they get worked inside the hour.
